## Audit outcome

This was a **B0 baseline**, with no capability library requested or loaded (`knowledge_words=0`, `actual_loaded_capabilities=null`). The observed behaviors are baseline actions, not evidence of knowledge adoption or library causation. The run ended normally with `end_turn` and a commit, not a budget or technical stop. Nevertheless, it was **formally unsolved**: official F2P passed 115/115, but P2P passed 1280/1281 and binary success was 0.

Sources: the supplied trajectory at `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_test_httpx-deterministic-cookie-store_B0_r1/infer_logs/httpx-deterministic-cookie-store/turn_1/trajs.json`; official result at the same run directory’s `eval_output/httpx-deterministic-cookie-store/eval_result.json`; and the supplied final patch and verifier output. All event IDs below belong to `main_agent`.

## Exploration and changes

The student created the requested `cookie-store` branch from `main`, searched for cookie integration, and read the existing model, client, export and type definitions (events 1–6, 10–11). It checked the missing public API, receiving `AttributeError` for `httpx.CookieStore()` (events 7, 12), then inspected request and redirect paths (events 19–24). A temporary reproduction likewise failed on the missing API before implementation (events 25–26).

The executable edits added a `CookieStore` mutable mapping in `/app/httpx/_models.py`, with parsing, domain/path and secure matching, expiry, prefix checks, deterministic ordering and limits. They also added request and client integration in `/app/httpx/_models.py` and `/app/httpx/_client.py`, widened cookie types in `/app/httpx/_types.py`, and exported the class in `/app/httpx/__init__.py` (events 27–32; final patch). The later type-fix edit also added conversion from `CookieStore` to existing `Cookies` (events 49–50, 54). The final patch changed four files; event 56 records commit `745a39a`, with 305 insertions and 9 deletions. No persistent new test file appears in that patch.

Some edit and read event bodies are truncated, notably events 27, 31 and 44; the supplied final patch permits inspection of the resulting code, but not every intermediate detail. The student’s final statement that implementation and local checks passed (event 57) is a claim supported in part by tool returns, not a claim of official success.

## Validation, regression and costs

The reproduction passed after implementation, but the first local cookie/client test run failed with many failures (events 33–35). The output is truncated; one displayed failure received an unexpected HTML response. A second run after removing several proxy variables still exited unsuccessfully and included Ruff import-order errors (events 37–38). After fixing imports and also removing `NO_PROXY` variables, the targeted suite reported **317 passed, 1 skipped** (events 39–40). The sequence does not establish the cause of every earlier failure.

Mypy then reported three errors, although the compound shell command’s overall return was successful because later commands ran (events 47–48). After a further edit, mypy and Ruff passed (events 49–50). Temporary checks covered combined headers, expiry, limits, host-only and secure behavior, prefixes, conflicts, and sync/async clients; they and the reproduction passed (events 51–53). These are local checks, not the official suites. The targeted tests preceded the final type-fix edit; the reproduction and edge checks were rerun afterward, but the targeted suite was not visibly rerun.

The official verifier identified a concrete regression in `tests/test_exported_members.py::test_all_imports_are_exported`: `/app/httpx/__init__.py` placed `CookieStore` before `Cookies`, contrary to the test’s case-insensitive sorted export order. This one P2P failure explains the reported binary failure; it is not necessary to speculate about unseen failures. Official F2P passed all 115 tests, while P2P had one failure and three skips. The verifier’s process exit code 0 is not equivalent to a passing grade.

The extra reproduction, repeated regression runs, formatting, type checking and edge-case scripts incurred work beyond the implementation; they found useful issues, although the broad reruns cost time and still missed the export regression. The temporary reproduction was removed before commit (events 55–56). Metrics report 28 requested and returned tool calls, 16 model requests, 912,145 input and 6,176 output tokens, 1,723.91 seconds wall time and 1,319.437 seconds SDK time. SDK `total_cost_usd=4.715125` is a **proxy estimate**, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is established.

## Evidence table

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Event IDs / source | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loaded capability | None in B0 | Attempt metadata; `actual_loaded_capabilities=null` | No adoption or causal attribution is possible. |
| Baseline exploration | Branch, searches, reads and failing missing-API reproduction | 1–26; `/app/httpx/_models.py`, `_client.py`, `_types.py` | Some returned text was truncated. |
| Implementation | Added store and integrated requests, clients, types and export | 27–32, 49–50, 54–56; final patch | Intermediate edit bodies partly truncated; final patch shows resulting changes. |
| Local verification | Reproduction and edge checks passed; targeted suite 317 passed, one skipped; mypy and Ruff eventually passed | 33–53 | Earlier runs failed; local checks are not official full success. |
| Official regression | Export-order test failed; F2P 115/115, P2P 1280/1281 | `eval_result.json`; `tests/test_exported_members.py:6` | Binary reward 0 despite near-complete test counts; no broader failure cause inferred. |
| Completion and cost | Commit and normal final response | 55–57; attempt and SDK metadata | Completion is not formal success; SDK cost is an estimate, not an actual fee. |
